metadata.description: Agent skills for content labelling: per-label metrics with intervals, slices, multi-label confusion, case search and rulebook lookup. Each skill is a standard-library script plus instructions.

plugins.name: label-metrics
plugins.description: Precision, recall and F1 for every label with 95% intervals, micro and macro F1, miss and false-alarm rates, and a paired comparison of two runs on the same items. Standard library only.

plugins.name: slice-report
plugins.description: Labelling metrics by slice (language, source, difficulty, length, label), with bootstrap intervals and a minimum slice size; names the slices that are measurably worse.

plugins.name: confusion-report
plugins.description: A confusion matrix that works when items carry several labels (MLCM), the most frequent confused pairs with item ids, and under-, over- and swapped-label counts.

plugins.name: case-search
plugins.description: Finds labelled cases that resemble a new item (BM25 for Chinese and English) and shows how cases containing a phrase were labelled.

plugins.name: label-rules
plugins.description: Looks up labelling rules in a JSON rulebook (applies, does not apply, boundaries between labels, keyword hints) and checks a rulebook for gaps.
